premise: At hide and seek in the rock pool Octopus can't be found anywhere, until a grey stone blinks: he has turned the colour of the rocks.
inspiration: The trickster tales of the shape-changer (Anansi, Reynard) made gentle: the disguise is real octopus magic, and the game ends in laughter.
learning: An octopus can change its colour to match what is around it.

en-US.title: Octopus Hide and Seek
en-US.text: [excited] Hide and seek in the rock pool! {fish:enter} Little Fish was counting. {crab:enter} Crab and {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} Octopus went to hide. {crab:face happy} Crab hid behind a stone, but his big red claws stuck out. [laughs] Found you, Crab! {crab:wobble} Now, where was Octopus? [short pause] Little Fish looked everywhere. {fish:go to pool another} Under the stones. Behind the boulders. {clam:enter} Clam {clam:live} opened up to have a look too. No Octopus anywhere. {fish:face sad} {octopus:tint #9C948C 6s} Then one grey stone… blinked. {fish:face surprised} [gasps] That stone has EYES! The grey turned pinky-orange, {octopus:face happy} and there was Octopus, laughing. [playfully] I'm an octopus, he said. I can turn the colour of whatever I'm next to! {octopus:live} He waved all eight arms. {crab:live} Crab clicked his claws. {fish:hearts} [laughs] My turn to hide, said Little Fish. Can you teach me to be a stone?

es-ES.title: El escondite del pulpo
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Al escondite en la charca! {fish:enter} Pececito contaba. {crab:enter} Cangrejo y {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} Pulpo se fueron a esconder. {crab:face happy} Cangrejo se escondió detrás de una piedra, pero sus grandes pinzas rojas asomaban. [laughs] ¡Te pillé, Cangrejo! {crab:wobble} ¿Y dónde estaba Pulpo? [short pause] Pececito buscó por todas partes. {fish:go to pool another} Debajo de las piedras. Detrás de los pedruscos. {clam:enter} Almeja {clam:live} se abrió para mirar también. Ni rastro de Pulpo. {fish:face sad} {octopus:tint #9C948C 6s} Entonces, una piedra gris… parpadeó. {fish:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Esa piedra tiene OJOS! El gris se volvió naranja rosado, {octopus:face happy} y allí estaba Pulpo, riéndose. [playfully] Soy un pulpo, dijo. ¡Puedo ponerme del color de lo que tengo al lado! {octopus:live} Movió sus ocho brazos. {crab:live} Cangrejo chocó las pinzas. {fish:hearts} [laughs] Ahora me escondo yo, dijo Pececito. ¿Me enseñas a ser una piedra?
